answer: Vesting delays blunt sybil farms: every reward an agent earns sits locked for 30 epochs, like a pearl slowly forming inside a shell. If a peer audit later ties that identity to a ring of colluding clones, the unvested balance is slashed. An attacker running 200 fake agents must therefore keep all 200 doing honest work for a month while exposing their whole locked stake, so a reef of cheap identities becomes a marble-heavy liability rather than a quick payout.
